caption: Figure 7: Node Coverage on the DFA: To generate a positive example that covers state 5 in the above figure, we first find a path P1 (dotted maroon) from the starting state 1 to state 5 . In this case, it is 1 →3 →5 . Then we find another path P2 (dashed brown) from state 5 to the accepting state 10
subject: how MESSI finds a positive test example covering DFA state 5 by chaining two paths, start to 5 to accept
